Thought: I need to analyze each hypothesis against the document segments. Let me go through them:

- nda-11 (No reverse engineering): Not mentioned anywhere. NotMentioned.
- nda-16 (Return of confidential information): Segment [26] says return within one week of written request. This is return upon request, not "upon termination" — but the hypothesis says "upon the termination of Agreement." Segment [26] mentions return within one week of written request. This is arguably entailment for return of CI. The hypothesis specifically says "upon termination" — the document says upon written request. The agreement remains in force in perpetuity [29]. I'd lean Entailment with evidence [26] since return obligation exists. Actually the hypothesis template is "destroy or return some Confidential Information upon the termination of Agreement" — the document triggers return upon written request, not termination. Could be considered Contradiction? Typically in these tasks, return upon request counts as Entailment. I'll verify with human feedback.
- nda-15 (No licensing): Not explicitly stated. NotMentioned.
- nda-10 (Confidentiality of Agreement): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-2 (None-inclusion of non-technical information): CI includes any information relating to clients — not limited to technical. Contradiction, evidence [23].
- nda-1 (Explicit identification): Not required. NotMentioned.
- nda-19 (Survival): Agreement remains in force in perpetuity [29] — obligations survive. Entailment, evidence [29].
- nda-12 (Permissible development): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-20 (Post-agreement possession): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-3 (Verbally conveyed information): [23] "disclosed whether in writing, orally or by any other means." Entailment, evidence [23].
- nda-18 (No solicitation): [27] "I will not attempt to contact the employees, customers, creditors, suppliers or landlords of any client" — that's no-contact, which is similar to non-solicit. Entailment, evidence [27].
- nda-7 (Sharing with third-parties): [25] says not disclose to third party without prior written consent — so may share with consent. Entailment, evidence [25].
- nda-17 (Permissible copy): [25] "make no copies thereof" — no copying allowed at all. Contradiction, evidence [25]. Actually "make no copies thereof not disclose it..." — no permission to copy. So Contradiction.
- nda-8 (Notice on compelled disclosure): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-13 (Permissible acquirement): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-5 (Sharing with employees): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-4 (Limited use): [25] "use it solely for the purpose as agreed between parties." Entailment, evidence [25].
